- Breakfast sausage pieces (3)
- Pineapple chunks

The total is about 211 g and about 221 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is plausible. Three small sausages weighing around 17 g each and a modest serving of fruit should come to roughly 200 g.
